source: Meta Ad Library (India, active ads) + the company's own live website

ads.text: Is your solar water heater not giving enough hot water like it used to? Expert repair, servicing and installation for all major solar water heater brands. Solar tube deep cleaning and scaling, leakage detection and fixes, full system health checkup and maintenance, new sales and complete setup. Prompt doorstep service available across Bengaluru and Hyderabad. Call +91 90666 31441.
Live Meta ad for solar water heater repair, servicing and installation across Bengaluru and Hyderabad, run by the agency 99Ad Solutions. Destination is a WhatsApp chat.
Google Ads Transparency: 4 live ads under identity-verified advertiser AR09270299175948386305 (VIJAYA KUMAR), all pointing at v1solarsolutions.com.

ad_library.summary: V1 Solar Solutions is the only lead in this batch advertising on both channels with a published email: 4 live Google ads behind a verified account (AR09270299175948386305) and a Meta ad (Library ID 1446165934284837, live since 12 Oct 2026) run by the agency 99Ad Solutions. The Meta ad is the only thing putting them in front of Hyderabad - the copy promises doorstep service across Bengaluru and Hyderabad and the click opens a WhatsApp chat. Proprietor Mr Vijay Kumar P; Bengaluru address; also listed as a manufacturer and service provider on IndiaMART under GST 29DPTPK0093G1ZF.

funnel.type: WhatsApp chat on Meta, own site on Google
funnel.meaning: The Meta side buys a conversation, not a lead record - no form, no email capture, nothing to follow up if the chat goes cold. The Google side lands on a site whose quote form does capture an enquiry.

findings: The Meta ad is the only channel putting V1 in front of Hyderabad, and it ends in a WhatsApp chat - no email, no form, no retargeting pool for the Hyderabad half of the spend.

Two live domains split the same business: v1solarsolutions.com (the real site, contact form, info@v1solarsolutions.com) and v1solarsolutuons.in - a misspelling - which carries their IndiaMART manufacturer listing and a different phone presentation.
Google rating is 1.0 from 2 reviews, against a Meta ad that leans on 'expert technicians' and 'prompt doorstep service'. The paid story and the public review record do not match.
The quote form is the strongest asset on the site - it captures product type (water heater / softener / heat pump / commercial RO) before the callback - and no ad sends traffic to it.

Scope is service-led: tube cleaning and scaling, leakage detection, system health checks and AMC across all brands, plus 100-500 LPD ETC and FPC heaters. That is a recurring-revenue story the one-off repair ad never tells.
next_steps: Give the Hyderabad ads a page of their own

The Meta ad promises Hyderabad doorstep service but lands in WhatsApp. A Hyderabad-specific page with the service list, a form and the Meta Pixel makes that half of the spend measurable and retargetable.
v1solarsolutuons.in splits the IndiaMART presence from the .com site and sends some enquiries to a different-looking business. A redirect fixes it.
1.0 from 2 reviews undercuts an ad built on expertise. Two or three verified reviews from recent service jobs change the click-to-call rate.
Sell the AMC, not the repair
Tube cleaning, leakage checks and system health checks are recurring revenue. A single AMC creative would out-earn the one-off repair message.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
